A thousand reasonable decisions, each aimed at keeping you slightly longer, add up to an environment that is hard to leave. The remedy, I suspect, will not come from users resisting, but from changing what the companies are rewarded for.

escucha.tema: Clase sobre memoria colectiva
escucha.guion: Societies don't remember; they commemorate, which is a different activity. Remembering involves uncertainty and revision, whereas commemoration tends to produce monuments and anniversaries, fixed and slightly proud. Neither is dishonest, but we should not confuse one for the other. A nation can hold a splendid ceremony each year for an event whose causes it has never seriously discussed. Historians are often unwelcome precisely because they reintroduce the doubt that the ceremony was designed to put to rest.
